name: Tsunomori Rona
source: Rona is a 16 year old girl who was dicovered by Coney working part-time at a donut store by the name of 'Viva Donuts'. She is a huge fan of SEVENTH SISTERS and has looked up to Nicole Nanasaki as a role model ever since she was in school.
